gemini.performance_metric: Chapter 11 bankruptcy filing and Section 363 asset sale
gemini.rationale: The provided slice documents that the company filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in May 2020 and subsequently sold its North American operating assets. However, it contains no specific evidence of realized disruptions at the product/process interface (p4) or the process/organization interface (p5).

grok.performance_metric: NA business 2nd Ch.11; §363 asset sale ~5yrs post-emergence
grok.rationale: The slice documents deregistration, a May 2020 Chapter 11 filing, non-performing sites with large associated costs, and a subsequent Section 363 sale of North American operating assets to Atlas Holdings with relaunch under new names, but contains no evidence that an acquired product failed to align with operating processes over time. Likewise there is no documented fracture at the process/organization interface; the only people-related note is continuity of prior senior management into the successor entity. Absence of pathway-specific realized disruption is therefore coded 0 for both p4 and p5.
